core_obligations: The author proves the two noncommutative subset-sum identities by a simultaneous induction that perturbs X and Y while keeping their sum central, preserves the order of products in injective tuples, and cancels the resulting ordered terms. This supplies an Abel-Hurwitz identity family without requiring pairwise commutation of the individual variables. Equivalent rearrangements, further identities and applications are bundled/context rather than extra counts.
